title: Resource Weave & Decision Diary — Customer POC (Daybook)
overview: This is a working daybook for the upcoming customer POC (mid-market SaaS search augmentation). Focus is on human + infra resourcing, callable contingency paths, and a compact decision ledger so stakeholders can quickly scan what changed and why. This is intentionally informal: quick notes, unresolved questions, and concrete runbook items for the first two-week onramp and the subsequent baseline-saturation week.
primary-objectives: Deliver a reproducible 2-week POC demonstrating <50ms median generation latency for 512-token prompts under controlled load (burst to 20 RPS).
End-to-end integration with customer sandbox (VPC peering) using Redwood Private, with a fallback to Hosted API for failover scenarios.
Produce cost/loss estimates, anomaly detection hooks, and a gating decision for Dedicated capacity on day 12.
success-metrics (pass/fail): Latency: median < 50ms for 95% of requests during steady-state (10 RPS), P95 < 120ms.
Throughput: sustain 200 tokens/sec per instance cluster for 3 consecutive 10-minute windows.
Quality: pass eval set (50 prompts) with >95% parity (manual label agreement) vs baseline model.
Deployment: zero PII leakage incidents, network ACLs in place, audit logs forwarding to customer SIEM.
timeline (high-level daybook): Day -7 (prep): provision sandbox, exchange SSH keys, customer signs PoP. Run basic smoke with hosted endpoint to baseline latencies. Owner: Aisha.
Day -3 (lab validation): deploy model variant v1.4-quant, run inference-profile job, collect token/sec and mem snapshots. Owner: Marcus.
Day 0 (kickoff workshop): 2-hour technical ramp with customer infra and app leads; collect acceptance criteria and traffic shaping constraints. Owner: Sofia.
Day 1-3 (integration): VPC peering + routing policies, secrets KMS handover, minimal proxy for header translation. Owner: Evan.
Day 4-7 (load tuning): gradational load test to 10 RPS, enable KV prefix caching, evaluate batching profiles. Owner: Marcus + SRE.
Day 8 (canary): A/B traffic split 10% -> 50% across model variants (fallback path validated). Owner: Lena.
Day 9-11 (observability and eval): wire console metrics, run eval harness, collect human-in-loop labels. Owner: Sofia.
Day 12 (decision gate): review metrics, propose Dedicated commit if cost/latency gains > 30% vs Hosted fallback. Owner: Leadership + Customer PM.
Day 13-14 (saturation & wrap): 24-hour soak at target load; final report draft. Owner: Marcus.

risk register (top-of-mind): Network egress constraints at customer side — Severity: high — Mitigation: pre-approve peering, provide proxy option to avoid NAT egress.
Unexpected model quality regression on long-tail prompts — Severity: medium — Mitigation: maintain hosted fallback and quick label loop.
GPU preemption / queueing during load — Severity: medium — Mitigation: token-bucket throttling + autoscale buffer.
Secrets key rotation mismatch — Severity: low-medium — Mitigation: pre-run KMS handshake and rotation test.
